name: The Lychee Martini
method: Combine all ingredients in a cocktail shaker with ice. Shake vigorously for 10-12 seconds and double strain.
glassware: Chilled martini or coupe glass, garnished with a lychee
source: Adapted from Grey Goose's Lychee Martini

name: Sparkling Lychee Lagoon
method: Fill a glass with ice. Pour in the blue curaçao and lychee juice and stir to combine, then top with sparkling wine, stirring gently from the bottom to keep the color layered.
glassware: Hurricane glass garnished with a lychee and lemon twist
source: Inspired by the classic Blue Lagoon mocktail spec
